$comment: COPY → ~/.paseo-claude-team/model-routing.local.json on EACH host. Never commit the local copy. Values below are real Claude model ids as of 2026-08; confirm with 'paseo provider models claude-peer --json' before relying on them. 'model' is the exact id Paseo expects in '<paseo-provider>/<model-id>' form. 'thinking' ∈ off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max and must be supported by the model. The point of these five classes is that the Lead routes by TASK RISK, not by habit: a monitoring sweep should not cost what a review costs.
